import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
titanic = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a bar chart to compare the survival rate of passengers by sex
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='sex', hue='survived', data=titanic)
plt.title('Survival Rate by Sex')
plt.xlabel('Sex')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Survived')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a violin plot to compare the age distribution of survived and non-survived passengers
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.violinplot(x='survived', y='age', data=titanic, split=True)
plt.title('Age Distribution by Survival Status')
plt.xlabel('Survived')
plt.ylabel('Age')
plt.savefig('output2.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a histogram to compare the fare distribution of survived and non-survived passengers
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.histplot(x='fare', hue='survived', data=titanic, bins=20, stat='density')
plt.title('Fare Distribution by Survival Status')
plt.xlabel('Fare')
plt.ylabel('Density')
plt.legend(title='Survived')
plt.savefig('output3.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
